say: Einstein was sure about this. He was wrong.
Two gloves. Two boxes. Far apart. Open one: left. So the other is right. No mystery.
Einstein said particles work the same way. The answer is already inside.
Quantum physics said something wilder. There is no answer, until you look.
Then, in the year nineteen sixty-four, John Bell found a test. A limit packed answers can never break.
Experiments ran it. Nature breaks the limit. Again, and again.
So these gloves were never left or right. Not until the box was opened.
Einstein once asked: is the Moon there, when nobody looks? The Moon, yes. Its particles decide nothing, until they are measured.
